# A05-S01: Name application

Extract from the operator’s source text. Omitted passages are marked […].

[…]

Dear Election Committee at the Ministry of the Interior

I have sent an application for approval of the party name ‘Det Syntetiske Parti’ to you. However, I did not receive a confirmation email, and there was also some technical trouble with Digital Post.

So I just want to ask if you can confirm receipt?

[…]
